meta.title: Great People
meta.scope: Regular Civilization VI Great People across DLC/expansions (including replacement/retired entries), plus Gran Colombia Comandantes Generales; scenario-only excluded.
meta.eraPolicy: The Era is the in-game Great Person era, not the lifetime. Comandantes Generales do not have ordinary era assignment (Unassigned).
meta.datePolicy: Years BCE stored as negative numbers. Approximate and uncertain dates are identified in birthYearLabel/deathYearLabel; unknown dates are null and sort last.
meta.pinPolicy: Pin at known birthplace or documented approximate birth region; legendary people left pinless. Representative locations carry a pinNote.
meta.greatWorksPolicy: Only in-game Great Works are listed for Great Writers, Artists, Musicians, and Sun Tzu.
meta.thumbnailPolicy: Filenames reserved; image files not included.
meta.colorPolicy: Reuse the Wonders era variables. Unassigned Comandantes Generales use the Wonders Industrial gray as a neutral fallback.
